_format: **word** is bold; {strikes} and {quick} are filled in by the game
tldrStory: **TL;DR** Survive **11 PM → 7 AM**{quick}. Keep prod up. Score as many bananas as you can.
tldrEndless: **TL;DR** There is no 7 AM. Pages come in **waves**; survive as many as you can. Between waves, **nap** for a bonus stage.

sections.title: The job
lines: The pager goes off: grab the phone on the **nightstand** (**E**), answer with **Q**.
Go to the **PC** in the desk room, find what's broken, pick the fix, then **actually do it**.

sections.title: Don't get fired
lines: Every incident climbs to **OUTAGE**. Leave it there and it's a strike. **{strikes} strikes** and you're fired.
Fast, clean fixes grade higher and pay more. Keep fixing to build a **streak**.

sections.title: More will come up
lines: Dave left notes. You'll get one the first time something new happens.
